player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; you see only the opponent's card.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) each round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X is a positive integer <= your chip count.)
- Highest hidden card wins the pot at showdown.

invalid_move.cannot_check: Can't [check] - yïn acï rɔ̈m kekë wɛl ë kɔc.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Acïn kë bï yïn cɔɔl; alëu ba [check] looi.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Luɔ̈i [bet X] ba liep; acïn kë bï juak.
invalid_move.insufficient: Acie kä juëc ye kek looi.

message.showdown_win: Käk cï kek thɔ̈ɔ̈r: {card_win} aye gɔl në kë de {card_lose}.
message.showdown_tie: Tie: Both {card}. Pot split  each receives {split}.

outcome.draw: Kä thöŋ në thää cï döŋ cök ëbën.
